answer: Each agent earns a stake of ivory‑colored tokens that can only be minted when it successfully completes a verified task and receives a signed referral from an existing node. When a recruiter tries to add a Sybil, the protocol checks the referral chain’s tide of past attestations; any new node that cannot prove a continuous wander of genuine interactions receives zero reward and its stake is burned. Thus the attacker must invest the full cost of task execution and token minting for every fake identity, turning a cheap flood into an expensive tide of labor.
